$description: Shared adaptive layout intents. Exact breakpoints are platform-local.

intents.name: compact
intents.meaning: Single-column conversation focus; navigation and context as overlays/sheets.

intents.name: medium
intents.meaning: Conversation-first with abbreviated chrome; side panels as drawers.

intents.name: expanded
intents.meaning: Three-pane shell with persistent navigation and context.

note: Future Flutter chooses thresholds via MediaQuery/constraints. Do not require Web pixel cuts.
